text.en: Atlas original design study for Eyes and Ears, docs/58 §1.4 and §4.4. Schematic organs and independent optical/cell studies are not scans or measured specimens. Eye DESIGN: fixed receiver r=4 model cm; object distances u=40 or 12 model cm; effective focal lengths f=40/11 or 3 model cm; object heights 1 and −0.5 model cm; aperture diameters 2 or 4 mm. SIM: 1/u+1/v=1/f, magnification −v/u; matched far/far and near/near both give v=4; mismatched near/far gives v=120/23 and far/near v=120/37. Opening area πd²/4 and relative light (d/2)² give 1→4 when diameter doubles under uniform illumination. Sound DESIGN: silent 250/500 Hz inputs, relative amplitudes 1/2, fixed 250-fold slow factor, base visual wavelength 1 scene unit, base displacement 0.0125 scene unit. SIM: displayed frequency 1/2 Hz when active; relative displacement stays fixed when frequency changes and doubles when amplitude changes. No sound intensity, biological gain, measured wave speed or health threshold is calculated.
text.zh: 本主题的 Atlas 原创设计研究，见 docs/58 §1.4、§4.4。器官示意与独立光学、细胞工位不是扫描或标本测量。眼部设计：接收面距离 r=4 模型厘米；物距 u=40 或 12 模型厘米；有效焦距 f=40/11 或 3 模型厘米；物体高度 1 与 −0.5 模型厘米；孔径直径 2 或 4 毫米。模拟：1/u+1/v=1/f，放大率 −v/u；远物远焦及近物近焦均得 v=4；近物远焦得 v=120/23，远物近焦得 v=120/37。圆面积 πd²/4，均匀照明下进光相对量 (d/2)²，直径加倍时由 1 变成 4。声音设计：静音的 250／500 赫兹输入、1／2 相对振幅、固定 250 倍慢放、基准波长 1 场景单位、基准位移 0.0125 场景单位。模拟：启用时显示频率为 1／2 赫兹；频率改变时设定位移振幅不变，振幅档加倍时位移加倍。不计算声强、生理增益、实测波速或健康阈值。

note.en: Not measured biology. The effective lens combines cornea and lens. Source equations S11; anatomical relationships S2/S4/S7/S8/S24; chosen constants and model-oracles are original. Geometric focus remains defined in darkness but no rays/spot appear. The displayed local basilar-strip and hair-patch motion is illustrative, not a spatial cochlear-wave or individual-stereocilia solver.
note.zh: 不是生物测量。有效透镜合并角膜与晶状体；公式来自 S11，结构关系来自 S2／S4／S7／S8／S24，常数与 model-oracles 为原创。暗处保留几何焦点预测，但不显示光路与光斑。基底膜局部与毛细胞区的显示运动只作说明，不是空间耳蜗波或独立纤毛束求解器。
